versions.content: Subfunctions of Diagnostic Services Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the definition of subfunctions of diagnostic services. Rationale: The definition of subfunctions is an important part of the definition of diagnostic services. Also, the existence of subfunctions for certain diagnostic services is regulated by the applicable ISO 14229-1 [2]. Use Case: The user wants to specify subfunctions for given diagnostic services. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
